title: Parse a URL query string into ordered pairs
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: It strips one leading "?", skips empty segments, splits at the first "=" and decodes "+" before percent escapes, with URIError coming from decodeURIComponent as the brief requires.
Destructuring segment.split("=") drops everything after a second "=", so "a=b=c" gives ["a", "b"] instead of ["a", "b=c"], while the pasted test run claims that case passed.
Cutting each non-empty segment at its first "=" and decoding with "+" replaced first produces exactly the pairs and errors the brief specifies.
It replaces "+" after percent-decoding, so "plus=%2B1" gives ["plus", " 1"] instead of ["plus", "+1"].
